purpose: Deterministic JSONL child boundary for the css-tree core API; not a candidate CLI requirement.

transport.request: one JSON object per line on stdin
transport.response: one JSON object per line on stdout
transport.stderr: diagnostics only; never parsed as a result

operations.parse-generate: parse a bounded CSS string, return plain AST and generated text
operations.tokens: callback token records with type, name, and source slice
operations.find: first, last, and all matches for an allowlisted node type
operations.lexer: property match result after parsing a value context

determinism.environment: TERM=dumb, CI=true, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, no proxy or registry variables
determinism.limits: one bounded child per request; no candidate stdout diagnostics
